target_boundary: The DomainSpec v2 backend structural proof implementation, from versioned machine sources and admitted profile selection through minted compilation, exact obligation/test derivation, execution, mutation, receipts, replay, and downstream consumer replay aggregation. UI, business semantics, release admission, and source mutation are outside this x-ray.

reader_states.runs-now: Checked-in behavior or evidence that can be rerun from the current repository.
reader_states.design-contract: Validated logical boundary frozen for Invoke Plan; not implementation evidence.
reader_states.build-next: Machine schema, runtime, evidence, or integration still to implement and validate.
reader_states.owner-gate: Exact admission, lifecycle, or release decision outside BTE self-assertion.

orthogonal_axes.evidence_status: source-backed, illustrative, replayed, stale, or absent
orthogonal_axes.admission_status: not-required, pending, admitted, rejected, or deferred
orthogonal_axes.topology: internal or external; topology is not a lifecycle state

mixed: inspect the record-level lifecycle, evidence, and admission fields

reader_contract.target_public: A reader who understands that DomainSpec describes systems but needs to see exactly what code exists, what must be added, how data moves, and how false-green proof is prevented.
assumed_knowledge: Source files can be validated and transformed into generated artifacts.
A test result is trustworthy only when the tested requirement and runtime target are traceable.
reader_contract.reader_reward: The reader can distinguish the checked-in UnlockDoor compiler proof from the validated but unimplemented BTE Design, follow one exact proof chain, and state what Plan must build versus what an owner must admit.

must_start_with: what Design has fixed and Plan must build
must_not_start_with: a claim that validated Design means implemented or admitted
opening_contract.failure_message: The opening must anchor the checked-in UnlockDoor source, identify current compiler evidence, label Design contracts separately from Build next, and preserve owner-controlled admission.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: Semantic contracts define allowed shape and meaning; owner decisions admit exact contracts or sets; authored inputs provide governed content.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Derived graphs, evidence, aggregates, and lifecycle decisions remain separate roles instead of collapsing into one authority flag.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Markdown plans and this x-ray explain the plane but do not belong to it.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The code that loads sources, checks their contracts, and emits a normalized graph plus provenance manifest.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It is the single bridge from authored meaning to derivation input.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: The current compiler still embeds edges in node connections and bypasses declared JSON body schemas.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The independent catalogue, derivation, test, binding, evaluator, execution, mutation, receipt, and replay machinery.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It detects missing work instead of trusting a producer's pass summary.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Most of this plane is required but not implemented yet.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A deterministic generated view of accepted nodes and edges, with stable identities but no authority to rewrite source.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: All obligation derivation must use the same graph the compiler actually produced.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: The existing Markdown-derived ConceptGraph is not the minted-project canonical graph.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A generated index joining graph IDs to exact source paths and content digests.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It lets every later result prove which authored bytes caused it.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A graph row without a matching source record must fail derivation.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The expected obligation set, frozen by an owner other than the generator implementer.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: A broken generator cannot shrink both the output and the definition of success.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: The engine must compare against this catalogue read-only and cannot overwrite it.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A typed, unique link from a test role to one fixture, adapter, runtime target, and evaluator.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It makes clear what code or contract is actually being exercised.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: The existing first-match binding lookup is insufficient and must not count as completeness proof.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A bounded checker that judges one structural claim independently from the generator that emitted the test.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Without it, generated tests can merely repeat the generator's own mistake.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: An evaluator proves only its declared scope, never arbitrary semantic truth.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: One declared semantic edit in a fresh child build, expected to trigger a named failure or remove a named causal effect.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: A passing positive alone cannot show the check discriminates valid from invalid structure.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A mutant killed by an earlier unrelated error does not prove its targeted criterion.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The receipt records the complete causal chain; replay recomputes it from raw artifacts instead of trusting the receipt's pass field.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Together they expose stale, missing, substituted, or tampered evidence.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A receipt is evidence and cannot admit a profile or release.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a newcomer, I want a one-screen map of the implementation.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: There are four separate planes: authority, compiler, proof, and consumers.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: preventing source definitions, generated artifacts, runtime code, and evidence from collapsing into one self-certifying system.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an implementer, I want to know what exists and what must be added.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: The shared kernel, body adapter, current compiler, graph/manifest, and deterministic legacy utilities are reusable, while the successor contracts, edge-source path, ProofContext resolution, exact comparator, strict binding/evaluator runtime, and complete receipt chain remain new work.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: turning the plan into bounded code changes instead of rewriting the whole engine.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a reviewer, I want to trace one criterion from source to proof.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Every stage consumes exact IDs and digests from the preceding stage, and any missing or stale join fails closed.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: showing how graph composability and test derivation are actually proved.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a planner, I want the implementation order forced by dependencies.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Machine contracts precede compiler changes; compiler outputs precede derivation; independent obligations precede exact comparison; execution precedes receipts; a green core precedes consumers.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: selecting safe implementation slices and avoiding circular proof.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a system owner, I want to know what BTE cannot do for itself.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Profile and relationship admission remain owner-controlled, while IOLM and Body War must produce fresh independently governed receipts after the core is green.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: preventing implementation code or downstream consumers from self-certifying DomainSpec authority.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an owner, I want the remaining build and admission gates visible.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Design now fixes the architecture and trust boundaries, but machine contracts, implementation, catalogue freezes, admissions, and consumer runs remain open; the stale Plan cannot authorize work.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: routing the next action to Invoke Plan without mistaking Design validation for implementation or admission.

evidence: The target claim is a structural chain from versioned machine sources through compiler, graph, obligations, tests, execution, mutation, receipts, replay, and independent consumers.
The current Define requires exact identities and digests at every transition and excludes UI, business semantics, and release admission.
The validated DESIGN.md supersedes the pre-audit architecture assumptions; the existing Plan and implementation layering remain stale and must be regenerated.
inference: A human workday followed by four architecture responsibilities is the clearest reading order: first see the work, then inspect the machinery that supports it.

evidence: The system must be deterministic, exact-set checked, digest-bound, fail-closed, replayable, and non-admitting.
Current-v1 and its successor require distinct identities, contracts, fixtures, digests, receipts, and admission states.
D_kind=13, D_form=16, D_structure=13, and candidate D_rel=16 remain separately named; graph node and edge instance catalogues are dynamic and cannot substitute for those static memberships.
Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, empty, skipped, todo, orphan, unrunnable, unsupported, and surviving-mutant states fail the affected aggregate.
inference: Each module boundary should accept and return versioned records with explicit identity and digest fields rather than sharing mutable in-memory state.

evidence: Existing reusable code includes meta-type-criteria.ts, meta-type-body-adapter.ts, resolver.ts, compiler.ts, generated MintedGraph and MintedSourceManifest records, and narrow conformance receipt verification.

The current derivation engine has deterministic graph, obligation, key, binding, emitter, residue, and receipt utilities but its main parser reads Markdown/aspect documents rather than the minted graph.

The validated Design requires the accepted successor profile, isolated formation-v2 contracts, JSON retirement/source migration maps, independent edge schemas/roots, ProofContext, independent O_spec, graph derivation, exact comparator, strict bindings, four bounded evaluators, runnable tests, clean child-lineage mutations, causal receipts, replay, and aggregates.

The checked-in key-and-door fixture provides a concrete UnlockDoor Operation, the Operation writes_state YAML criterion, the DoorUnlocked Event, source-backed produces and enforces edges, their MintedSourceManifest joins, a compiler mutation control, and a minted build receipt.
inference: The safest implementation adds a minted-project proof path beside the legacy Markdown path and reuses only deterministic utilities whose contracts match, rather than widening the legacy parser or IR silently.

Plan should organize concrete modules around the Design interfaces for contract loading, ProofContext resolution, obligation derivation/comparison, test runtime, evidence, replay, and aggregate commands.

evidence: Machine formation-v2 and retirement contracts must exist before the successor compiler route can become core-eligible.
The compiler's graph and source manifest are prerequisites for minted obligation derivation.
O_spec must be frozen independently before O_gen exact-set comparison can prove completeness.
Unique bindings and evaluators are prerequisites for executing required tests.
Execution and killed-mutation records are prerequisites for receipts and replay.
SWU-BTE-008 core proof is a prerequisite for consumer proof.
inference: The Design layering seed orders shared contracts, formation migration, independent sources, compiler/graph, catalogues, one complete proof unit, full core, parallel consumers, then terminal aggregate.

evidence: Formation, profile, relationship, validation, and release owners control decisions or admission outside the implementation modules.
IOLM and Body War are independent downstream consumers and can run only after receiving the verified green core aggregate handle.
The Node.js toolchain, TypeScript, node:test, and Vitest are existing runtime dependencies.
No remote service or LLM belongs in the deterministic proof path.
inference: Owner actions should enter the implementation as signed or digest-bound machine handles rather than copied Markdown assertions.

evidence: Authored project, feature, node, and future edge JSON are resolved and hashed before validation.
Profile and registry bindings select kinds, formation contracts, relationships, source layouts, and governing digests.
The compiler must emit deterministic normalized graph and source-manifest artifacts.
Minted derivation emits O_gen from graph nodes/edges plus governing contracts and compares it to independent O_spec.
Each obligation must lead to a TestCase, unique Binding, independent Evaluator, ExecutionResult, paired MutationResult, Receipt, replay verdict, and aggregate membership.

IOLM and Body War consume the verified green core aggregate handle, emit consumer-owned raw evidence plus non-authoritative receipts, and submit those raw artifacts to BTE-owned replay. The consumer aggregate consumes exact fresh ReplayResult handles, not receipt assertions.

For key-and-door.UnlockDoor, the live source body state_change=yes satisfies Operation/writes_state; changing it to no is observed to fail with FORMATION_INVALID and ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-MISMATCH before graph emission.
The key-and-door generated graph contains UnlockDoor --produces--> DoorUnlocked; the source manifest joins the edge to unlock-door.json and the Event to door-unlocked.json with exact content digests.
The key-and-door generated graph contains HasKeyRule --enforces--> UnlockDoor, and its source manifest joins that edge to has-key-rule.json with an exact content digest.
inference: A typed artifact pipeline with immutable JSON records between stages is preferable to a monolithic verify command because each join can be independently replayed and mutated.
The intended practitioner flow is three loops: make intent explicit, turn intent into exact implementation work, then make the evidence portable for consumers and owners.

evidence: Design fixes the versioned replacement and proof boundaries; Plan must materialize them as implementation units without weakening the gates.
Implementation then builds and validates machine contracts, compiler breadth, derivation/runtime, evidence/replay, core aggregate, and consumer aggregate in dependency order.
Any source or governing-contract byte change invalidates downstream bindings and receipts and reopens the affected denominator.
Receipts remain non-admitting and final release state stays owner-controlled.

The concrete process instance distinguishes pre-run TestCase and Binding records from post-run ExecutionResult and MutationResult records, then joins them through a replay-required non-admitting Receipt target.
inference: Each implementation slice should ship one red control first, then the positive path, then a replay/tamper control, so false-green behavior is visible throughout development.
The workday timeline is a target operating narrative, not proof that the unfinished BTE derivation, replay, and consumer stages run today.

evidence: These boundaries are designed and frozen for Plan; versioned machine schemas, validators, implementation, replay evidence, and owner admissions remain outstanding.
required_structure is loaded but not evaluated; Interface and Mapping domains are too weak; Value Object equality is substring-based.
The current source resolver reads project, feature, and node JSON only; edges still come from node.connections rather than independent edge roots.
The current test-derivation entrypoint parses Markdown/aspect documents, not MintedGraph plus MintedSourceManifest.
The current binding resolver returns the first subset match and the emitter can generate todo/skip cases, both forbidden by completeness requirements.
The current Plan and Implementation Layering contain superseded formation-authority and readiness assumptions and must be regenerated from DESIGN.md.
inference: The Design forbids the legacy ConceptGraph from becoming the minted proof input and forbids first-match Binding semantics; deterministic utilities may be reused only behind compatible contracts.
A custom proof-chain visual pattern is warranted because the starter x-ray library cannot represent exact-set equality plus causal digest propagation honestly.

evidence: L0 static HTML and CSS/SVG can explain the implementation without remote rendering.

The canonical x-ray library provides boundary, node, layer-panel, risk-marker, arrow, branch, feedback-loop, timeline, risk-matrix, dependency-boundary, lifecycle-stack, and evidence-inference-split primitives.
inference: Use neutral surfaces for long reading and reserve accent colors for semantic state: existing, proposed, owner-controlled, external, or blocked.

Place a status-coded human workday timeline before the machinery, then compose four toggleable responsibilities, a left-to-right artifact pipeline, a tabbed three-instance record explorer, a positive/negative diagnostic branch, a reuse-versus-build map, the accepted dependency seed, and a remaining-gates matrix.
Use a local custom exact-proof-chain pattern for O_spec/O_gen/Test/Execution/Mutation equality; record it as an extension nudge rather than canonical library authority.
